lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Performance task: plan: the floor plan design

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows how to plan before computing anything.

items.prompt: A rectangular garden bed is 6 ft long and 3 ft wide. What is its area?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Decide what the quantities are before you compute anything.

items.prompt: A rectangle 4 units long is split into two parts: one 5 units wide and one 2 units wide. Use 4 × (5 + 2) to find the total area.
A rectangular rug is 3 m long and 4 m wide. What is its area?

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Plan in writing: what you will figure out, how, and how you will check it.

items.prompt: A rectangle 5 units long is split into two parts: one 6 units wide and one 4 units wide. Use 5 × (6 + 4) to find the total area.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A rectangular rug is 8 ft long and 3 ft wide. What is its area?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
